gen-gf-unica-one-gf-faustina: Faustina reads at a gentle pace, its bowls thinning softly and its capitals barely rising above the lowercase. And Unica One stands over it with every stroke drawn at a single thickness, a display voice with no shading at all.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-halant: Unica One has the plainness of signage, every line the same weight. Halant sits below with a faint thick-thin shift and a towering x-height, so the headline feels stamped and the text feels quietly lettered.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-headland-one: Unica One draws round letters like bent wire, with a very large lowercase eye and daylight inside every curve. Headland One adds shaded texture beneath.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-hedvig-letters-serif: Unica One holds a steady, marker-like line weight, its big open curves letting light into every letter. Hedvig Letters Serif brings brush-drawn softness below.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-lisu-bosa: Commanding is how Unica One lands, its stems and arches all of identical thickness. Lisu Bosa then carries the longer text, tall and sturdy, with counters spilling into the space around them and a nib-drawn tilt to each line.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-marcellus-sc: Fixed-width nib strokes give Unica One its look, every curve the same heft as the next. Marcellus SC supplies the contrast, with bowls that thin gracefully and terminals pulled well back.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-montagu-slab: Refined is the body's mood, and Unica One is its opposite, with no hairlines and no swells anywhere. Montagu Slab carries a sizable x-height and robust downstrokes against slender turns, so a long text goes down comfortably.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-serif-hentaigan: Refined describes the body, yet Unica One brings curves with the heft of a rope and a distinctive, commanding stance. And Noto Serif Hentaigana does the quieter work, its subtle thick-and-thin rhythm giving small letters near-capital height.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-ovo: Flat-brush strokes, all one weight up top. Ovo underneath has a tall middle band and thins only slightly, and that gap between uniform Unica One and its mild contrast is the pair's charm.
gen-gf-unkempt-fs-karma: Unkempt is expressive and commanding, with a t whose crossbar and stem match in weight. Karma follows with a trustworthy, classic modulation, its compact lowercase height a steadier counterpoint to the moodier heading.
